messages:
leah-sales: Urgent: Nimbus POC demo hitting 504s and 429s during guided walkthrough. Customer getting nervous. Can we triage?
tom-se: On it. Which endpoints, and do you have a sample request that reproduces?
leah-sales: They were hitting chat-stream with ~180 qps steady, bursts to 350 when they loop a script. Errors: 504 gateway_timeout and some 429 rate_limit_exceeded. Demo in 45m.
ben-ops: Pulling edge logs and quota service now. ops-bot: [alert] org=org-nimbus env=eval severity=critical 2026-04-10T15:04:12Z code=504 message="upstream gateway timeout"
ben-ops: Quota service shows org cap rate=200/s burst=250. Their retry loop is amplifying requests because client retries every 200ms. We're hitting the token-bucket drain.
tom-se: That explains 429. 504s likely from backend queueing and request timeouts as workers are saturated. Are there any autoscale actions?
ben-ops: Autoscaler tried to scale but was rate limited by cloud API after 2 attempts. Scale cooldown=60s. Current pool=4 workers, desired=11.
anya-support: Customer also sent the security questionnaire earlier. They're worried about routing to hosted fallback; they asked about data residency and ephemeral logs. Leah, they may refuse hosted fallback unless we get explicit approval.
leah-sales: They prefer no hosted fallback. Can we do faster short-term fixes purely on eval infra? They asked about a temporary increase to their org quota for the demo.
ben-ops: We can bump org quota manually. Cold-provisioning new GPUs will take ~9-11 minutes. Faster option: increase burst to 400 and patch the rate-limit so their client sees fewer 429s when bursting, plus instruct them to backoff. That is instant and buys time.
tom-se: Also can we enable smart retry suppression at the edge (dedupe repeated identical requests for 2s)? That would cut amplification.
ben-ops: Implemented edge dedupe: `edge feature toggle set dedupe-window --org=org-nimbus --window=2s` 
ops-bot: [quota] org-nimbus quota:update rate=400 burst=400 applied by ben-ops at 2026-04-10T15:06:18Z
ben-ops: After bump, edge 429s dropped to near zero, 504s reduced but still occuring sporadically due to one overloaded worker process. Dumping that pod's logs: ```2026-04-10T15:05:58Z ERROR request_id=abc123 task=generate latency=11234ms message="worker timeout waiting for model kernel" 2026-04-10T15:06:01Z WARN memory=93% event=gc_pause```
anya-support: That worker looks like a memory pressure OOM soon. We should cordon and spin replacement. Also capture the customer consent for any route changes. Leah can you confirm?
leah-sales: Got verbal ok for infra-only fixes. They still want no hosted routing. Approving worker recycle and quota bump.
ben-ops: Replaced worker pod and forced a small canary rollback for latest runtime patch. New worker is healthy. Metrics: p95 exec time down 40%, queue depth halved.
tom-se: We also pushed a client guidance note: reduce retry frequency to exponential backoff starting at 500ms, jitter. Sent to customer.
leah-sales: Customer running the script again now 
ops-bot: [alert] org-nimbus latency: p95=840ms p99=2.1s qps=320 2026-04-10T15:12:03Z
ben-ops: We still see sustained qps ~300 which is above long-term safe rate for eval pools. For long-term we should propose a short Dedicated trial. Leah, pricing: we can offer a 4-week reserved eval at 30% off list for demo-critical periods.
leah-sales: Noted, will pitch. Also add a clause about temporary capacity increases for scheduled demos.
tom-se: Follow-ups: 1) Add an alert for token-bucket exhaustion per org 2) Lower autoscale cooldown for eval pools to 30s 3) Add client retry guidance to our quickstart 4) Consider prewarm workers for scheduled demos.
anya-support: Also answered security concern: no persisted customer logs were routed to hosted fallback; infra-only actions kept data inside org VPC. Customer satisfied.
leah-sales: Demo finished, customer happy with response time. Thanks team. Please dump config diffs and ticket notes so legal & sales have audit trail.
ben-ops: Pushed note to ticket: manual quota bump + edge dedupe + worker recycle + canary rollback. Will file infra-issue to change default eval quotas and cooldowns.
leah-sales: Great. I'll follow up with formal pricing and contract addendum for Dedicated trial. :white_check_mark:
